champion_support_items: Multiple dome-shaped, skin-colored papules present on the face and periorbital region
Biopsy showing buds and cords of basaloid cells with focal clefting
Splice-site mutation in SUFU gene (c.757-2A>G) detected in all tissue samples
response.margin: R3 fully integrates the clinical presentation (multiple skin-colored papules), histopathology (basaloid buds/cords with clefting), and the pathogenic SUFU splice-site mutation, encompassing the syndrome's multisystem features. C1 is a redundant completion of R3, adding no new evidence. R5 captures only the histologic pattern and fails to address the genetic and syndromic context.
